summary: Candidate preserves all problem statements and correct answers accurately, but two figure bboxes point to wrong content: p2-fig3 captures problem 4 (parachutist) instead of the cubes diagram, and p1-fig3 captures problem 9 text instead of problem 8 circuit.

defects.description: The bbox [660,760,970,960] for p1-fig3 (problem 8 circuit) is incorrect. The crop shows text from problem 9 ('През два консуматора тече винаги един и същ ток, ако консуматорите са:') instead of the electrical circuit diagram for problem 8 ('Когато ключът от схемата е отворен:'). The figure is displaced downward or to the wrong location.
defects.suggestedFix: Adjust bbox to point to the circuit diagram location; likely [660,730,970,850] or similar to capture problem 8's circuit properly.

defects.description: The bbox [640,340,960,470] for p1-fig2 (problem 5 box positions) captures mostly white space and text ('ая теглото е едно и същ') with only a small partial box diagram visible. The three distinct box position diagrams (labeled 1, 2, 3) are not clearly shown in the crop.
defects.suggestedFix: Expand or reposition bbox to capture all three box position diagrams; may need to adjust y-range upward and/or x-range.

defects.description: The bbox [60,870,560,990] for p2-fig3 (cubes pressure diagram for problem 10) is incorrect. The crop shows text from problem 4 (parachutist: 'скорост 6 m/s. Колко е приблизително големи-ната на силата на съпротивление на въздуха F') instead of the pressure diagram showing two cubes with different sizes creating equal/different pressures. The figure is located in the right column of page 2, not the left column.
defects.suggestedFix: Reposition bbox to right column; approximately [560,850,980,990] to capture the cubes diagram for problem 10.
